## Important Details to Note
- File Size: Because images and stylesheets are encoded directly into the HTML code, the final .html file size will be larger than standard web pages.
- Deprecation Notice: You might see older tutorials online referencing self-contained: true. Quarto officially deprecated that option—embed-resources: true is the current, modern way to handle standalone document bundling.
